messages.subject: CFA with cluster-robust SEs
parts:
Hi all, I am trying to conduct a CFA with data that was collected among individuals nested in teams. Because my variables are only at level 1, I am trying to account for any non-independence due to team membership by using cluster-robust SEs.

My first question is: is this the proper/appropriate approach, or should I not be using cluster-robust SEs in the CFA, but only in the path analysis?

My second question is: which result labeled "robust" am I supposed to use in the cases where the statistic has two results both labeled "robust"? See example below:


Thank you for your help!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: CFA with cluster-robust SEs
parts: should I not be using cluster-robust SEs in the CFA, but only in the path analysis?
There is nothing about latent variables that invalidates cluster-robust SEs.
which result labeled "robust" am I supposed to use in the cases where the statistic has two results both labeled "robust"?

Option 2
